metadata.name: AI Gateway Workspace
metadata.description: References the service-provisioned default workspace or writes workspace policies, then deploys child configuration.
Default workspace configuration. Additional named workspaces require preview RP support verification before extending this type.
Alias wire properties for the preview routes contract.
Route to a catalog model. Lower priority wins; weight is relative within a priority group.
Provider kind selects its required configuration.
Cost limit policy. Amounts are whole USD in this draft.
Token limit policy with public counter dimensions.
MCP or URL-based OpenAPI upstream endpoint.
Tool server wire properties. Connector-backed servers are deliberately excluded.
Provider configuration and nested catalog models.
Typed inline governance policies supported by this draft.
Optional. The preview service provisions the default workspace automatically.
Optional. Inline workspace policies. Null leaves existing policies unchanged; an empty array clears policies.
Optional. Model providers and their models.
Optional. Secure values used by child resource configurations.

metadata.name: AI Gateway Model Provider
metadata.description: Configures a Foundry or custom provider and its model catalog.
Provider configuration and nested catalog models.
Provider kind selects its required configuration.
Cost limit policy. Amounts are whole USD in this draft.
Typed inline governance policies supported by this draft.
Token limit policy with public counter dimensions.
Optional. Models registered under this provider.
Optional. Secure upstream API key values.

provider.name: [format('{0}/{1}/{2}', parameters('aiGatewayName'), parameters('workspaceName'), parameters('name'))]
provider.properties: [union(createObject('kind', parameters('properties').kind, 'displayName', parameters('properties').displayName, 'description', tryGet(parameters('properties'), 'description')), if(equals(parameters('properties').kind, 'Foundry'), createObject('foundry', createObject('endpoint', parameters('properties').foundry.endpoint, 'resourceIds', parameters('properties').foundry.resourceIds, 'authentication', variables('wireAuthentication'))), createObject('custom', createObject('endpoint', parameters('properties').custom.endpoint, 'authentication', variables('wireAuthentication')))))]

metadata.name: AI Gateway Foundry Upstream Role Assignment
metadata.description: Grants Azure AI User and Cognitive Services OpenAI User on an upstream Foundry account.
